Difficulty levels

Each question's level comes from how the school's own S5 students did on it. The item difficulty is the question's Partial Credit Rasch model value from that year's results, in logits; 0 is average for that year's cohort and negative values are easier. Gates at split the questions into four levels.

Each year's values are measured against that year's own students, so a level means “easy or hard for that cohort”. Levels from different years are close but not exactly comparable. 2022–23 has no response data: its levels are judged by comparing each question with measured questions of the same kind. Click a question's badge to see its rank, average score and reason.
